name: SparkplugRow
description: One virtualised Sparkplug tree row: group, edge node (status, problem badges, hover actions), device, or metric (value with unit, quality, flags, type, age, copy). Rows are aria-activedescendant items of a focusable tree, so the keyboard reaches every row however far it is scrolled.

props.name: row
props.description: SparkplugTreeRow from build-sparkplug-tree (kind: group | node | device | metric).

props.name: nowMs
props.description: Reference now for relative ages (from the store snapshot).

props.name: domId
props.description: DOM id, referenced by the tree's aria-activedescendant.

props.name: isActive
props.description: The keyboard cursor is on this row. Its actions join the tab order.

props.name: treeFocused
props.description: The tree has keyboard focus, so the active row shows a ring and its actions.

props.name: isHighlighted
props.description: Flashes a node row revealed from a warning.

props.name: compact
props.description: Narrow panel: drops the type column and folds status badges into one warning icon.

props.name: onActivate
props.description: (row) a click: moves the cursor here, toggles a scope row or opens a metric's message.

props.name: onRequestRebirth
props.description: (node) asks for a rebirth (confirmed by the caller). Disabled for offline nodes.

props.name: onCopyMetricList
props.description: (node) copies the node's metric list as JSON.

notes: Figma is not linked yet; stories use local fixtures. Node actions are hover-revealed (same affordance as MqttTopicRow's broker-status button), and shown on the keyboard cursor row.
